values.description: TAE Model API base URL. Change to your deployed URL in production.
JWT access_token for a faculty/teacher account. Get this from POST /teacher/register or POST /teacher/login. The test scripts auto-save this. Format: paste only the token string (without 'Bearer ').
JWT access_token for a student account. Get this from POST /student/register or POST /student/login. The test scripts auto-save this. Format: paste only the token string (without 'Bearer ').
UUID of an assignment. Auto-populated by the 'Create Assignment' request test script. Can also be set manually from the Get All Assignments response.
UUID of a submission. Auto-populated by the 'Upload Student Responses' request test script. Can also be set manually from the Get Portfolio response.
UUID of an evaluation result. Auto-populated by the 'Evaluate Student Responses' request test script.
